description: Germany only. German employment law, Germany only: the ten follow-up workflows of the Lintelly workbench (HR-Workflows), e.g. payroll input deadline, missing onboarding documents, sick leave with eAU and BEM, maternity protection, probation decision, fixed-term contract signed before start. Each shows the chain 'when ... then ...' with default days and roles. Use it as a template for your own reminders. Without kennung it lists all ten.
